statement: You are given coin values coins and a target amount. You have as many coins of each value as you want.
Return the smallest number of coins whose values add up to exactly amount.
If no combination of coins makes amount, return −1.

examples.explanation: 5 + 5 + 1 = 11 uses 3 coins, and no 2 coins can reach 11.
Coins of value 2 only make even amounts, so 3 cannot be made.
